editorial:
Imagine landing a job that seems like a dream come true, only to find out your boss is hiding some seriously dark secrets. You follow a young guy who starts working for a wealthy older man, but the tasks he is asked to do quickly get weird. The vibe is tense and makes you feel uneasy as you watch the main character slowly lose his sense of right and wrong. It starts off slow, but once the secrets start coming out, you will find yourself leaning in to see just how far this partnership will go before it all falls apart.

The acting is surprisingly solid and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the middle feel a bit dragged out, the payoff is definitely worth the wait. If you love stories about power and manipulation, you should check this out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend night when you want something that keeps your brain working.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking reveal that the older man was using the young worker as a fall guy for his crimes all along. Just when you think the young man has won, the boss flips the script and frames him for a murder. In the final scene, the worker realizes he was just a pawn in a game. He ends up trapped and broken, showing that lying to a pro always ends badly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and twist endings.
